title: stellaria
intro: Stellaria, commonly known as starweed or false mallow, is a perennial herb belonging to the Caryophyllaceae family. The plant is valued for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of fever, sore throats, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Stellaria include its ability to calm inflammation and reduce oxidative stress, making it a potential treatment for various conditions, including respiratory issues and wound healing. The bioactive constituents responsible for these effects include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which have been identified as the primary compounds contributing to the plant's medicinal properties.
